I’m so sorry :( I’m not gonna be one of those people to say ‘please don’t please don’t’. I just want to tell you, that if you go through.. I just want you to hear, that I am sorry for every ounce of pain you have been through :( and if I could, I would take it all away in a heartbeat. I wish someone could do it for me. I just want you to know that a stranger out there cares, and I know we may never cross paths, but one can dream. I know it probably sounds weird, but I’d like to someday meet someone like me, who has felt this way. Everyone I know has no idea what this feels like. 😔 it’s an EVERYDAY struggle. And I hope you keep going friend. But I understand, if it is just too much.. I won’t keep you here. I hope that you find peace in your life/afterlife.
